description: This file defines Croatian (hr-HR) culture info for the Date.js library, including date formats, localization strings, regex patterns, and date manipulation functions specific to the Croatian language and locale.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components (hours, minutes, seconds, milliseconds) of the date object to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a new Date object with the same timestamp.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this date with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this date is equal to another date.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day of the week given its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month of a specific year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone name for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a zone name.
